inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative source-aligned character count for one answer.
outputBoundary: Classify the answer as below the described requirement under 250 characters and meeting it at or above 250 characters; equality meets the requirement.
limitations: This binding does not choose how a character is counted; byte, code-point, grapheme, and normalization semantics remain an upstream source-profile input.
This binding does not clean answer text or derive its character count.
This binding does not construct questions, prompts, or typing sessions.
This binding does not determine completion across the source protocol's three answers per session or eight sessions.
This binding does not extract touch or keystroke features or run an authentication model.
A missing answer character count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
